description: A production-ready Clean Architecture template for .NET 10 with Aspire orchestration, CQRS, DDD, PostgreSQL, JWT Authentication, Permission-based Authorization, Health Checks, OpenTelemetry, and comprehensive testing. Get started quickly with a well-structured, production-ready solution.
releaseNotes: Version 1.0.1: Fixed Entity Framework Core version conflicts, restored Visual Studio launch settings, and excluded editor configs from template. Version 1.0.0: Initial release of Clean Architecture Template with Aspire. Includes support for .NET 10, 9, and 8. Features CQRS, DDD, PostgreSQL, JWT Authentication, Permission-based Authorization, Health Checks, OpenTelemetry, Swagger/OpenAPI, Minimal APIs, Docker support, and Architecture Tests.
title: Clean Architecture Template with Aspire
